name: ATL Workforce Youth Apprenticeship Program
what_you_do: Work a paid, part-time trade job at Atlanta's airport while you earn school credit. Placements match the trades your school district offers.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors in Clayton County, Fulton County, or Atlanta city public schools.
pay_detail: Paid, part-time. The page does not state a rate.
deadline_text: Rolling. The page says applications are accepted based on the airport's needs and may vary each year.
how_to_apply: Ask the work-based learning teacher or the counselor at your school. You can also apply on your own on the City of Atlanta jobs site.
notes: Ask your school's Work-Based Learning Coordinator first, since credit comes through your school. The airport's Registered Apprenticeship is for ages 18 and up, so it is not listed here. Questions: atlworkforce@atl.com.
